name: DunDraCon
blurb: A long-running tabletop and board game convention over Presidents' Day weekend, self-described as the West Coast's premier game convention.

editions.evidence: Hotel page: 'Santa Clara Marriott, 2700 Mission College Boulevard, Santa Clara, California 95054... Earliest Arrival Date: Thursday, February 11, 2027 Latest Departure Date: Tuesday, February 16, 2027'; homepage: 'Welcome to DunDraCon 50!'

notes: The seed's city (San Ramon) is stale/wrong: the official hotel page gives the venue as the Santa Clara Marriott, 2700 Mission College Boulevard, Santa Clara, CA 95054 (the same hotel used by BayCon/Westercon 79 at a different time of year), so city/region were corrected to Santa Clara, CA. This is DunDraCon's 50th year ('Welcome to DunDraCon 50!'). The con runs on volunteer Game Masters, seminar leaders and dealers rather than a booked celebrity guest program -- no 'Guests of Honor' page or section exists on the site -- so guests is set to 'none'. The site is a plain, old-style multi-page (non-JS) site; only one link rendered outside of what is likely a left-hand frame/menu not captured by the renderer. No og/twitter image; cover uses the homepage's own title banner graphic (hero:0, 1250x300).
